services.name: Sunset Table Reading
services.desc: Sun Wah Centre Rooftop, 268 Keefer Street (Select floor R in elevator. If entering through parkade, park at 7/F and then walk/roll up ramp through gate to the roof.) Please join us for a sunset reading on the rooftop of the Sun Wah Centre. Christian Vistan will read the Sunset Table in its entirety, joined by several readers whose practices explore themes such as archives, familial history, time, weather, and phenomenology. Re-released on the occasion of Flooding at Gallery Gachet, Sunset Table presents as an exercise in mapping distance.
